Bangkok to Koh Samui

Fly BKK to USM in about 70 minutes, or van-plus-ferry via Donsak if you like the long way.

FlightAbout 70 minutes to USM
Ferry pathVan to Donsak plus boat, a half day
SeasonEasier January to September

USM transfers are short. Chaweng is close. The opposite coast still deserves a booked car at night.

Ways to go

ModeTimeNotes
FlightAbout 70 minutesUSM is the point of Samui. Bangkok Airways and others.
Van and ferry8-10 hoursCheaper. Use it when the flight is silly money.
Via Surat Thani trainLongA romance, not a first-week plan.

Common questions

Why is the Samui flight expensive?
USM is a private-concession airport. Price it against a Surat ferry day before you decide it is a scam. Sometimes the ferry wins.
